title: Inverse problem for a multi-term time-fractional diffusion equation with the Caputo derivatives
summary: This paper investigates an inverse source problem for a multi-term time-fractional diffusion equation with Caputo derivatives. The source term is separable as \(f(x)g(t)\), with the unknown spatial component \(f(x)\) reconstructed from an overdetermination condition at interior time \(t_0 \in (0, T]\). The elliptic part is governed by a self-adjoint positive differential operator \(A(x, D)\) of order \(m \ge 2\).
